target_statement: Determine whether the Connes--Consani semilocal Hardy off-diagonal for u_F=rho_infinity rho_2 rho_3 rho_5 has an exact, normalization-compatible boundary compression whose logarithmic derivative factors or uniformly controls the completed-zeta Ward/Poisson mismatch A^(1/2)(P_Q-P_h) at the p=5 support event.
trust_model: Operator identities are to be derived exactly. Any matrix comparison is an ordinary high-precision finite Galerkin diagnostic, not interval arithmetic and not a continuum theorem.
first_unproved_edge: An intertwining identity from the Hardy/Sonin polarization of multiplication by u_F to the old/collar support compression of the logarithmic derivative -i u_F^* partial_t u_F, with the pole and reference-form corrections explicit.
mask_or_node_class: F={infinity,2,3,5}; each Euler factor retains all powers before support compression. The finite Ward target uses the first p=5 event L5=2 log 5 and literal two-sided collars.
source_data_retained: Exact gamma ratio, exact Euler ratios for p=2,3,5, their full infinite prime-power expansions prior to support truncation, Hardy orientation, Cayley Jacobian, pole rank two, and the log-Bessel reference multiplier.
coefficient_cone_and_sign: Complex Hardy data for the operator identity and real parity-complete compactly supported trial functions for the Ward comparison; no componentwise absolute values are licensed.
normalization: rho_v(z)=gamma_v(z)/gamma_v(1-z), z=1/2+it; Fourier transform fhat(t)=integral f(x)e^{-itx}dx; project support L means f is supported in [-L/4,L/4], and n activates when 2 log n<L.
height_window_and_one_sided_floor: Not a zero-height calculation. The old Weil floor may collapse; the proposed control must be relative to Q-energy rather than its L2 floor.
quantifier_order: First derive an infinite-dimensional identity at a fixed finite place set and support boundary; only then test finite compressions. A numerical singular-vector match cannot substitute for the identity.
resolution_required: Hardy truncation, old mesh, and collar mesh must each be refined. Comparisons require an explicitly isometric transform between coefficient spaces, not equal matrix dimensions by fiat.

rate_and_exponent_ledger.support_modulus: Qualitative quasi-inner compactness gives no floor-independent Ward constant; any surviving estimate must be uniform on a compact support slab.
rate_and_exponent_ledger.spectral_budget: Compare the boundary-compressed logarithmic derivative of the Hankel/Toeplitz defect with B^*A^{-1}B relative to the reference-harmonic collar metric.

feasibility_or_nonvacuity_witness: Connes--Consani prove P_-M_{u_F}P_+ compact, and the prior Ward audit found a bounded combined-source ratio near one despite collapsing old Ritz floors.
downstream_socket: A genuine uniform factorization would imply HRW; together with NR_log and the residual diagonal estimate it would feed adjacent-support Schur propagation toward a uniform zero-free strip.
why_not_target_renamed: The test keeps the established Ward target fixed and asks whether the literature operator is its missing arithmetic square root, rather than defining a new defect after seeing the data.
abstract_convex_falsifier: Reject a proposed bridge if it is merely the universal Toeplitz identity I-T_u^*T_u=H_u^*H_u with no logarithmic-derivative or support-compression intertwiner.
fejer_falsifier: Check Hardy orientation and phase reversal: rho_F versus its reciprocal swaps the two Hardy off-diagonals but must not change the self-adjoint Weil source except by the predicted sign.
prime_density_pseudonode_falsifier: Preserve the full local factors until support compression; compare the exact p=5 contact with the previously defined outward smear only after differentiation.
finite_actual_prime_diagnostic: Construct converged Fourier/Cayley Hankel blocks, verify unimodularity and the analytic log-derivative formula, then compare only through an explicit Paley--Wiener/support map to the existing Ward matrices.
actual_prime_arithmetic_line: The product over all selected places must be differentiated before any source separation or norm bound.
decision_tree_change_if_proved: Promotes semilocal quasi-inner structure to a concrete candidate proof of HRW and isolates a quantitative compact-defect estimate as the next theorem.
decision_tree_change_if_refuted: Retires the direct Hankel-to-Poisson bridge and leaves Krein/Green-DtN identities as the credible source-complete routes.
stop_rule: Stop the direct comparison if no exact isometry connects the Hardy and support spaces, if differentiation produces a noncompact bulk term unrelated to the Hankel defect, if pole/reference terms cannot be separated without assuming the target positivity, or if rank/parity/scaling invariants disagree under refinement.
